description_en: Queries a list of resource diagnostic reports
description_zh: 调用DescribeDiagnosticReports查询资源诊断报告列表
kebab_example: aliyun ecs describe-diagnostic-reports --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --report-ids dr-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --resource-ids i-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --status Finished --severity Normal --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiagnosticReports

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of diagnostic report IDs
parameters.name: report_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
The report status. Valid values:

InProgress: The diagnosis is in progress.
Failed: The diagnosis failed.
Finished: The diagnosis is complete
parameters.help_zh:
报告状态。取值范围：

InProgress：诊断中。
Failed：诊断失败。
Finished：诊断完成
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The severity level. Valid values:

Unknown: The initial state, which indicates that the diagnosis has not started or the diagnosis process exited abnormally. No diagnostic conclusion is available.
Normal: The diagnosis is normal and no issues are found.
Info: Related information is available and may be associated with an exception.
Warn: Related information is available and may cause an exception.
Critical: A critical exception exists
parameters.help_zh:
严重等级。取值范围：

Unknown：初始状态，表示未开始诊断或者诊断过程程序异常退出，无诊断结论。
Normal：诊断正常，没有发现问题。
Info：有关联信息，可能与异常相关。
Warn：有关联信息，可能导致异常。
Critical：有关键异常
parameters.name: severity

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the `NextToken` value returned in the previous call. You do not need to set this parameter for the first request
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token）。取值为上一次调用接口返回的`NextToken`参数值，初次调用接口时无需设置该参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: 100.

Default value:

If this parameter is not set, the default value is 10.
If the value you set is greater than 100, the default value is 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页行数。最大值为100。

默认值：

当不设置值时，默认值为10。
当设置的值大于100时，默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned in this call
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值
